name: Vorssaint
tagline: Bring your everyday Mac utilities together and enable only the modules you need.
description:
Vorssaint collects a set of compact Mac utilities in one modular application. Its tools are designed to be switched on individually, letting a user assemble a lightweight utility belt instead of installing a different menu-bar app for every small task.

## Features

- Enable only the modules needed for a particular Mac setup.
- Reach common tools from a compact interface without opening a full productivity suite.
- Use utilities for recurring desktop, clipboard, file, display, and system tasks as provided by the current release.
- Configure module behavior independently so unrelated tools do not have to remain active.
- Run as a native Apple-silicon application with a macOS-oriented interface.
- Receive new or expanded modules as the application evolves.

## Where it fits

Vorssaint is aimed at Mac users who prefer one configurable utility collection over many single-purpose downloads. That convenience comes with a wider permission surface than a narrowly focused app, so it is worth enabling modules gradually and comparing any critical function with a dedicated alternative.

## Privacy and requirements

Vorssaint requires macOS 14 or later and an Apple-silicon Mac. Individual modules may request Accessibility, Screen Recording, clipboard, file, or notification access when their function requires it. Review each prompt in context rather than granting every permission preemptively.

## Pricing

Vorssaint is free and open source.
